subject: Re: IAM evidence request for Ceres Health - SSO & RBAC follow-up
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cereshealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Katie Zhou <katie.zhou@cereshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: IAM evidence request for Redwood - SSO, SCIM, RBAC

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier — good conversation and excited about the potential fit. As discussed, our security team needs a few items to progress the procurement and vendor approval: 

- Current SOC 2 status (Type II report or SOC summary).
- SSO support: SAML metadata, IdP/Service Provider flow doc, and any known limitations (multiple domains, sign-on methods).
- SCIM provisioning: supported endpoints, schema version, and account lifecycle behaviors (deprovisioning).
- RBAC & admin controls: role definitions, who can create service credentials, and emergency admin procedures.

We usually start a vendor security questionnaire — if you can point me to a security contact or drop the documents into a shared folder, that speeds things up. Ideal timeline from our side: artifacts in ~3 business days, then a quick review call.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
IT Security, Ceres Health
alex.turner@cereshealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cereshealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IAM evidence request for Redwood - SSO, SCIM, RBAC

Alex — great to meet you on the call, appreciate the clear checklist. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Recap:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for the 12-month period ending 2026-03-31; we can share the SOC summary and request to provide the full report under an NDA.
- SSO/SAML: we support SAML 2.0 (SP-initiated & IdP-initiated). We will provide the SP metadata and a short guide for common IdPs (Okta, Azure AD).
- SCIM: SCIM 2.0 support for user/provisioning/updating/deprovisioning. We will include endpoints and expected attribute mappings.
- RBAC: predefined roles (admin, owner, editor, viewer) plus service-role for API keys. Admin controls include MFA requirement for admin role and audit logging of privilege changes.

Action items & owners:
- Dev: attach SOC summary, SP metadata, SCIM endpoint doc (Dev Patel) — target: 3 business days.
- Dylan: prepare a short RBAC + admin controls note and link to audit log docs.
- Me: share Drive link to upload artifacts and coordinate the review call.

I’ve CC'd Dev and Dylan to pull the artifacts together. We’ll drop the items into the Drive folder here: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Ceres-IAM (will share access to your security distribution list). If you prefer, we can sign an NDA and provide the full SOC report via DocuSign.

Proposed next step: 30-min review call on Thursday 2026-07-23 or Friday 2026-07-24 — does either work for you?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0118

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IAM evidence request for Redwood - SSO, SCIM, RBAC

Adding the checklist from engineering — I’ll assemble the artifacts and drop into the shared Drive folder by end of day Wednesday (2026-07-22):

- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC summary, contains contact for full report request).
- saml-metadata.xml (SP metadata).
- scim-endpoints.md (endpoints, example payloads, mapping table).
- rbac-admin-controls.md (role table, MFA requirements, admin approval flow).

Notes / caveats:
- SOC full report: available under NDA only; Marissa to coordinate NDA/DocuSign if they want the full Type II report.
- SCIM: supports groups via "groups" attribute but there is a small delta with one of Ceres' legacy attributes — we will call that out in the scim-endpoints.md.
- SAML: no planned support for IdP-initiated with multiple tenant redirects without a small config change; we will document the recommended config.

Attaching stubs to this message for quick reference: [attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf] [attachment: saml-metadata.xml] [attachment: scim-endpoints.md]

—Dev

2) We will need the SOC Type II report under NDA. Can you send the DocuSign link or next steps for that?

Thursday 7/23 works for a 30-min slot — prefer 10:00–10:30 PT. If that’s not available, Friday morning also works.

Appreciate it — talk soon.

Alex
